question: Which firmware update fixed lost-link problems on the DJI Matrice 30T?
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance claims that if a loss of control link hazard occurs, the action is to reestablish the control link with the small unmanned aircraft. FAA guidance also claims that two certificated remote pilots transferring operational control may do so only if they are both capable of maintaining Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) of the small unmanned aircraft without loss of control. There is no usable evidence for the DJI Matrice 30T manual in the approved collection. There is no usable evidence for DJI Matrice 30T incident reports in the approved collection. There is no approved evidence about any firmware update fixing lost-link on the DJI Matrice 30T.
